comment: The FLIPPED row of the in-game gate: what a player who opened the Mod Settings screen and typed did. Every name here is a stock base 2.0 item, fluid or science pack, so the row loads on an install with no other mod. quench-medium goes to custom and its text names a FLUID, which is legal only because the quenching recipe is crafting-with-fluid; tips-research-tier goes to custom, which is the arm that prices a research out of three settings and places it by its own Position ladder; rivet-ingredients is the whole list of a recipe with no dropdown in front of it; and chain-links goes to the long PRESET while chain-ingredients is left untouched, so the row also covers a text nobody edited. tips-count is spelled whole and tips-seconds with a fraction, so the file carries the signed 64-bit encoding and the double encoding into the same engine run.
